# Daniellog

> Technical blog by Daniel:  on AV-over-IP networking, AVB/Milan (IEEE 802.1 TSN), pro-audio infrastructure. Content is plain static HTML, free to crawl,
> quote, and cite.

- [All posts](https://dnlzm.github.io/daniellog/posts/): article index, newest first
- [Tags](https://dnlzm.github.io/daniellog/tags/): posts by topic
- [About](https://dnlzm.github.io/daniellog/about/): author and scope
